why: err.message in a response leaks hostnames, index names and connection detail. The client gets a controlled message or a correlation id; the stack goes to the log.
bad: return reply.code(500).send({ error: { code: 'INTERNAL', message: err.message } });
good:
request.log.error({ err }, 'unhandled');
return reply.code(500).send({ error: { code: 'INTERNAL', message: 'internal error', correlation_id: request.id } });
